description: This file contains utility functions for creating ZIP archives, either from a list of file paths on disk or from in-memory byte data, for use in a larger software project.

methods.name: bytes create_zip_from_files(file_iter: Iterable[Tuple[str, str]])
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from an iterable of (arcname, file_path) tuples by reading files from disk and returning the ZIP as bytes.

parameters.name: file_iter
parameters.description: An iterable of tuples where each tuple contains the archive name and the file path on disk.

methods.name: bytes create_zip_from_memory(files: Iterable[Tuple[str, bytes]])
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from an iterable of (arcname, data_bytes) tuples, with data stored in memory, and returns the ZIP as bytes.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: An iterable of tuples where each contains the archive name and the file content as bytes.
